pages.title: The Field Guide Pendant
pages.text:
The **Field Guide Pendant** is this book made small and hung on a brass chain. Wear it in one of your three necklace slots in the [#](7A3C9A)[Accessories](entry://glossary/curios)[#]() screen (**G**) and the book is always with you:

- **I** opens the Field Guide.
- **Shift + I** opens [#](2E5AAC)[Ask the Book](entry://start_here/welcome)[#]().

Nothing has to be in your hands, and the keys work anywhere in the world. Change them under Options > Controls > Field Guide.\
\
The keys only work while the pendant is worn. Holding it, right-click opens the Field Guide, the same as the book.

**When the book answers**\
A worn pendant has no slot to glow green in, so the notice that slides in when an answer lands shows the pendant and the key: **[Shift+I]** in front of the page's title. Press it to open your pages; the answered page still glows under All pages until you read it.
A Field Guide, two Brass Sheets, a Chain and a [#](2E5AAC)[Precision Mechanism](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#](): a Brass Age piece.
